description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' providing static methods to facilitate logging in Android applications. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, allowing chaining of LogNode instances for custom log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging messages at various priority levels, and managing a linked list of LogNode instances for customizable logging output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode instance to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Passes log data (priority, tag, message, throwable) to the current LogNode for output.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a VERBOSE message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a DEBUG message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an INFO message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a WARN message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an ERROR message, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an ASSERT-level message, with optional Throwable.
